templateDescription.codex: Runs the installed Codex CLI through the built-in ACP bridge.
templateDescription.claude-code: Runs the installed Claude Code CLI through the built-in ACP bridge.
templateDescription.cursor: Runs the installed Cursor CLI over ACP. The default command is agent acp. Authenticate with agent login, CURSOR_API_KEY, or CURSOR_AUTH_TOKEN.
templateDescription.grok: Runs the installed Grok CLI over ACP. The default command is grok agent stdio. Authenticate with grok login, or set XAI_API_KEY.
templateDescription.acp: Runs an agent executable that supports ACP over standard input and output.

account.signalingOffline: Server connection interrupted. Existing peer sessions remain available until their authorization expires.
account.enrollmentRevoked: This computer was removed from its team. Reconnecting gives it a new, empty identity; its previous local data stays on disk.
